scripts.lint: pnpm types:core && oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings --tsconfig tsconfig.core.json src && oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings --tsconfig tsconfig.tools.json scripts test tsdown.config.ts
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm types:core && oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings --fix --tsconfig tsconfig.core.json src && oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings --fix --tsconfig tsconfig.tools.json scripts test tsdown.config.ts
scripts.test: pnpm types:core && pnpm build && node --test --test-reporter=tap test/*.test.ts
scripts.check:project: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
